profile.name: TRAN THANH PHUONG DANG
summary: Senior Mobile Engineer with 6+ years of experience building production-grade mobile platforms across Fintech, Cryptocurrency, and MarTech domains.

iOS-focused Mobile Engineer with strong expertise in Swift and UIKit, and extensive experience integrating React Native into large-scale production applications. Experienced in owning projects end-to-end, making architectural decisions, and balancing in-house solutions with third-party integrations to reduce dependency risks in high-risk fintech environments.
